import os
from openai import OpenAI

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse
from embeddings_client import get_embeddings_client


def embed_batch(payload, config=None):
    client = get_embeddings_client(config)
    request = EmbeddingRequest(texts=payload['texts'])
    response = client.embeddings.create(model='text-embedding-3-small', input=request.texts)
    return EmbeddingResponse(embeddings=[item.embedding for item in response.data])

import numpy as np

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingResponse


def similarity_score(embedding1, embedding2):
    embedding1 = np.array(embedding1)
    embedding2 = np.array(embedding2)
    cosine_similarity = np.dot(embedding1, embedding2) / (np.linalg.norm(embedding1) * np.linalg.norm(embedding2))
    return {'similarity_score': cosine_similarity}

import os
from openai import OpenAI

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse
from embeddings_client import get_embeddings_client


def embed_for_search(query, documents, config=None):
    client = get_embeddings_client(config)
    query_request = EmbeddingRequest(texts=[query])
    document_request = EmbeddingRequest(texts=documents)
    query_response = client.embeddings.create(model='text-embedding-3-small', input=query_request.texts)
    document_response = client.embeddings.create(model='text-embedding-3-small', input=document_request.texts)
    return EmbeddingResponse(query_embedding=query_response.data[0].embedding, document_embeddings=[item.embedding for item in document_response.data])

import os
import json
from openai import OpenAI

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingResponse
from embeddings_client import get_embeddings_client


def embedding_job_summary(job_id, config=None):
    client = get_embeddings_client(config)
    job_details = client.embeddings.retrieve(job_id)
    return {'summary': job_details}

import os
from openai import OpenAI

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingRequest, EmbeddingResponse
from embeddings_client import get_embeddings_client


def multilingual_query_translate(query, target_language, config=None):
    client = get_embeddings_client(config)
    translation_response = client.translations.create(model='text-davinci-003', source='auto', target=target_language, text=query)
    translated_query = translation_response.choices[0].text.strip()
    return {'translated_query': translated_query}

import os
from openai import OpenAI

from embeddings_models import EmbeddingResponse
from embeddings_client import get_embeddings_client


def retrieval_audio_brief(search_results, config=None):
    client = get_embeddings_client(config)
    audio_response = client.audio.create(model='tts-1', input=' '.join(search_results))
    return {'audio_brief': audio_response.url}
